panels.title: Core Geomap: two frames, Europe view
panels.description: Two queries give two frames: A (Berlin, Paris, Madrid) and B (Rome, Warsaw, Athens). Core draws the markers of the first frame only.

panels.title: ECharts Geo: two frames, Europe view
panels.description: Two queries give two frames: A (Berlin, Paris, Madrid) and B (Rome, Warsaw, Athens). Core draws the markers of the first frame only. The same view and layer options as the core panel beside it.

panels.title: Core Geomap: Size and color from a field
panels.description: Eight European capitals with a `value` field. The size scales from 2 to 15 over the `value` range, and the color comes from the thresholds of the field (green, orange at 50, red at 80). Opacity 0.6.

panels.title: ECharts Geo: Size and color from a field
panels.description: Eight European capitals with a `value` field. The size scales from 2 to 15 over the `value` range, and the color comes from the thresholds of the field (green, orange at 50, red at 80). Opacity 0.6. The same options as the core panel beside it.

panels.title: Core Geomap: Square, rotation and text from fields
panels.description: Squares of size 8 in `blue`, turned clockwise by the `heading` field. The `name` field is the text, left-aligned 12 px to the right of each marker.

panels.title: ECharts Geo: Square, rotation and text from fields
panels.description: Squares of size 8 in `blue`, turned clockwise by the `heading` field. The `name` field is the text, left-aligned 12 px to the right of each marker. The same options as the core panel beside it.

panels.title: Core Geomap: Plane icon, rotation and alignment
panels.description: Plane icons of size 12 in `purple`, turned clockwise by the `heading` field. The symbol alignment is bottom, so each icon is 12 px below its position before the turn.

panels.title: ECharts Geo: Plane icon, rotation and alignment
panels.description: Plane icons of size 12 in `purple`, turned clockwise by the `heading` field. The symbol alignment is bottom, so each icon is 12 px below its position before the turn. The same options as the core panel beside it.

panels.title: Core Geomap: two markers layers, second from query B
panels.description: Two markers layers. `Capitals` (red, size 8) has no query, so it uses the first frame (A). `Ports` (blue, size 5) uses the frame of query B, and it draws over `Capitals`: at Lisbon the blue marker is on top.

panels.title: ECharts Geo: two markers layers, second from query B
panels.description: Two markers layers. `Capitals` (red, size 8) has no query, so it uses the first frame (A). `Ports` (blue, size 5) uses the frame of query B, and it draws over `Capitals`: at Lisbon the blue marker is on top. The same options as the core panel beside it.

panels.title: Core Geomap: Tooltip Details, data link
panels.description: Tooltip mode Details. A hover shows each field of the marker row. A click pins the tooltip, and the pinned tooltip shows the data link "Search <name>".

panels.title: Core Geomap: Fixed style, star, rotation and text
panels.description: Fixed values only, as the layer editor sets them: star icons of size 10 in `orange` at opacity 0.7, turned 30 degrees. The fixed text `City` is 8 px right and 8 px up, left aligned, on the bottom baseline.

panels.title: Core Geomap: Size range, clamped rotation and text from fields
panels.description: Triangles from 4 to 20 px by the `value` field, in the color of `value`. The `turn` field turns each triangle, clamped to 360 degrees. The `value` field is the text.
